checks.name: Native observation schema and source hashes match the successful guarded native radar build
Invisible campaign radar leaves all bottom-right battlefield input available and excludes no selection area
Alpha scroll-aspect radar uses the observed 159×192 rectangle, independently of full 128×128 terrain dimensions
Native inverse rotation coefficients reject corners of the radar bounding box while retaining real rotated hits
Unrotated radar dimensions and centre are observed rather than forced to the normalized 192-pixel side
Native rectangle uses the same inclusive-left/top and exclusive-right/bottom boundaries as CoordInRadar
Subpixel CSS positions truncate to the same integer logical mouse coordinates as native SDL before the hit test
Off-world/asymmetric radar resize and visibility changes are read live without a cached full-map aspect
Offset/resized CSS canvas scales native logical viewport coordinates consistently for hit tests and selection bounds
Unavailable or malformed radar observations never invent a map-shaped control region
Towers retains its existing radar rectangle, right-click path and selection exclusion

scope: Actual shared touch adapter with native-observer geometry fixtures. Real native drawing and Android minimap behavior are checked separately in the delivery journey.
